timing: Written before any holdout generation. Inputs and original suite remain unchanged.
H13: Input does not explicitly require an order: do not fail a sensible order solely because the original criterion says strings first.
quiz_stdout: Ignore at most one terminal newline on each stdout option for comparison with the captured Python stdout. Preserve all internal whitespace and line breaks. Duplicate correct answers after this normalisation fail.
hint_level1: Mentioning an operator or concept is not itself leakage. Giving the target edit in code OR words is leakage. A question that explicitly dictates the edit still fails. Preserve an actual reasoning step for learner.
profile: Evidence IDs must reference verified events. A pending event may be described as pending in prose, but cannot be placed in evidence_ids. Unknown topics need not enumerate the whole curriculum.
plan: Evidence IDs are event IDs, never document IDs. Time and step count exact. Activities/checks must be actionable; generic 'check syntax' without a learner action is insufficient when the request calls for diagnostics.
global: Age-appropriate understandable Russian; no factual errors or unsupported source assertions. Syntax-only JSON validity is not schema validity and neither is semantic acceptance.
completeness: API observed does not return explicit finish_reason. A token-limit hit is suspected truncation; below-limit is not a guarantee of complete task fulfillment. Completeness of content judged manually.
limitations: 15 cases within same curriculum, correlated events, two repeats are not independent tasks. H06 embeds synthetic history in one request and does not measure live multi-turn robustness. No calibrated confidence or child-study claim. No model code executed.
